Camera preview and capture use this device. This Development build does not upload captures or require a cloud account to take a photo or video.
Camera permission enables the local preview and capture. Microphone permission is requested only when you choose to start video with audio. Denying microphone access leaves audio recording off.

Available lenses and video features depend on device hardware. Captures are saved through Android shared media. This Development candidate does not claim Stable, cloud backup, synchronization, or AI capture features.
Replay the startup guide at any time or turn contextual hints on or off globally. Permission prompts remain separate and appear only when their capability is requested.
